candidates.name: Military cable
candidates.rationale: A bounded military-grade logistics component fits Admiral's expeditionary procurement role and does not directly grant combat capability. Current external vendor evidence indicates it is not sold directly by traders, making it a stronger Relationship candidate than early vanilla special-equipment duplicates.

candidates.name: Toolset
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Mechanic assort directly contains the Toolset with unlimited stock. Relationship progression should not spend a slot duplicating an already-renewable vanilla source.

candidates.name: Weapon repair kit
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Ref assort already contains the weapon repair kit with unlimited stock. Admiral may only use it later if the relationship role supplies a deliberately bounded alternative with a justified access distinction; it is not approved for materialization now.

candidates.name: Body armor repair kit
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Ref assort already provides this item with unlimited stock and its reference value is exceptionally high. Duplicating it would add both overlap and large economic pressure without a unique Admiral capability story.

candidates.name: Leatherman Multitool
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Mechanic assort directly exposes the multitool with unlimited stock; adding it as relationship progression would create low-value duplicate availability rather than a meaningful Admiral privilege.

candidates.name: Signal Jammer
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Mechanic assort directly exposes the jammer with unlimited stock. It is also a vanilla quest-placement tool, so Admiral duplication would be convenience stock rather than relationship progression.
